sources.summary: A passage for migratory fish and a cycle route have been added to Afsluitdijk, an iconic dam in the Netherlands, in a recent revamp by Dutch studio Benthem Crouwel. Afsluitdijk is a landmark 32-kilometre-long dam built between 1927 and 1932 to protect the Netherlands from storm surges and flooding caused by the North Sea.
